sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा भरत: श्रीमान् दु:खशोकपरिप्लुत:।अभ्यधावत धर्मात्मा भरत: कैकयीसुत: ॥ २.९९.२९॥
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā bharata: śrīmān du:khaśokaparipluta:।abhyadhāvata dharmātmā bharata: kaikayīsuta: ॥ 2.99.29॥

translations.english: Beholding Rama, Bharata the majestic and righteous son of Kaikeyi overwhelmed with grief and distress rushed towards him.
